admin.approveOne: Install it first. Windows asks for approval once.
admin.lead: These change Windows itself, so Windows asks an administrator to approve them, once for all of them. The prompt names Windows PowerShell, which runs them. They run first, while you are here; the rest needs nobody.
admin.longPaths: Lets downloads with deep folder paths succeed.
admin.skip: Skip for now. What needs them will not work until they are installed here or on the Setup screen.
admin.approveAll: Install them first. Windows asks for approval once, for all of them.

disk.warning: Less than 50 GB of disk space is free. The installation and the AI models need about that much, and running out part-way is hard to recover from.

done.failed: The backend stopped while starting. Its log shows why.
done.laterDetail: {{items}}: fix them on the Setup screen when you are ready.
done.starting: The first start downloads and prepares the AI models, so it takes a while.

features.lead: Choose what you will use. Setup only downloads what these need. Open a group for its features and settings.

install.approval: {{tasks}} need administrator approval. Install them now, or later from here or the Setup screen.

causes.certificate: A download was refused because the connection is inspected and its certificate is not trusted. Check your network settings, or try another network.
causes.disk: The disk is full. Free some space, then retry.
causes.filesInUse: Files that setup has to replace are in use. Close other Smart Classroom windows, then retry.
causes.network: A download failed. Check the network settings, then retry.
causes.other: A step failed. The details below show what it reported.
causes.backendRunning: The backend is using files this step replaces. Stop it on the Services screen, then retry.
causes.declined: Windows asked for administrator approval, and it was not given. Try again and approve the prompt; it names Windows PowerShell.
causes.rateLimit: The model hub is turning away downloads from this network for now. Wait a few minutes, then retry, or download from the other model source (network settings).

welcome.countdown: Installing with recommended settings in {{seconds}} s
welcome.lead: Smart Classroom needs Python, the packages it runs on, and its AI models. Setup downloads several gigabytes and installs everything for you. It takes a while, and you can leave it running.
